summary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: BIOT) furnished a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a September 30 press release that CelSiege Biosciences appointed BIOT as non-exclusive authorized introduction and business development representative for IN01, a clinical-stage EGF-targeting cancer immunotherapy, in Japan and China. The Letter of Authorisation was signed September 18, 2026 by CelSiege founder Johan Indot. No price, stake, or deal terms are stated; any transaction remains subject to separate negotiation, diligence, and definitive agreements. This is an ordinary commercial business-development contract, not a special situation; watch for any subsequent definitive licensing or investment transaction.
